title: Billiger.de Product Offers Scraper
description: Compare Billiger.de product offers by shop, price, shipping cost, availability, seller rating, and offer link. Batch product IDs to review merchants in one run.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Billiger.de offers by product ID, including shop, price, shipping, and availability. Compare merchants in one run and export current offers to CSV.
storeCopy.intro: Collect merchant offers for a Billiger.de product, including shop names, prices, shipping costs, stock text, and seller ratings. Batch product IDs to compare several listings together.
useCases: Pricing teams can compare current merchant prices and shipping costs.
Online retailers can track seller availability and ratings for competing products.
Shoppers can export offer links and sort merchants before making a purchase.
howToUse: Add a Billiger.de product ID to `product_ids` for each lookup.
Choose a sort order and optional offer conditions.
Set page and result limits, then export one row per shop offer.

faqs.question: What does one result represent?
faqs.answer: Each dataset row is one shop offer returned for a product. A product with several merchants can produce several rows.
